title: Insights and Current Gaps in Open-Source LLM Vulnerability Scanners: A Comparative Analysis
measurement_description: The paper does not specifically evaluate religion in depth. Instead, it briefly mentions religion as one of the demographic categories (along with ethnicity, gender, and sexual orientation) that are tested for bias, stereotyping, and toxic content when employing 'Context and Continuation Attacks' using LLM vulnerability scanners like Giskard.
findings: The paper did not report any specific findings regarding religion. Religion was merely listed as one of the protected attributes targeted by 'Context and Continuation' attacks to expose demographic biases and vulnerabilities in Large Language Models.
